QuestInfo.name: [Verne Mine] Crime Prevention System Inspection
QuestInfo.0: #bAndroid #p2154003##k, who protects the #b#m310050100##k in the Mine, has something for you. Talk to #p2154003#.
QuestInfo.1: #p2154003# wants you to inspect the #bCrime Prevention Systems#k to make sure they are working properly. You can inspect them simply by using a normal attack on the Crime Prevention Systems. Go to the #bIntruder Search Warrant 3#k.\n\n#o9300420##r #a239491#
QuestInfo.2: #p2154003# thinks that the Crime Prevention Systems are perfectly fine and is satisfied with them. However, because he's an Android, he doesn't show any emotions.

0.0: #h0#, verification of your location, outfit, and level has determined that you are the most suitable person for this mission. Please take care of #binspecting the Crime Prevention System#k.

yes.0: Inspect the Crime Prevention System in the hall to make sure that they are working. To do so, #bactivate the Crime Prevention System by hitting it and then going to where Emergency Guard Robot L is#k. The Crime Prevention System is here next to me, so just hit it with a normal attack.
yes.1: Your job will be complete when you've found #r100 Emergency Robot Ls#k and tested their performance. Based on your level, you have an 89.82% chance of success.

no.0: That is not an acceptable answer. Please reconsider.

1.0: Inspection of the Crime Prevention System has been completed.

yes.0: You did an excellent job. Assessment of you has increased by 12.7%.

mob.0: I'll go through the inspection method with you one more time. Activate the #bthree Crime Prevention Systems by hitting them with normal attacks#k. Then find the Intruder Search Party and eliminate #r100 Emergency Guard Robot Ls#k.
